scope: Hash-bound multiclass calibration evaluation for frozen tone predictions
validated_behaviors: All five polarity probabilities are finite, bounded and sum to one.
A unique probability argmax and raw confidence must match the frozen prediction.
Missing and abstained predictions remain in the total denominator with null probabilities.
Multiclass Brier score, ten fixed reliability bins and ECE are deterministic.
Dataset, run, predictions and probability rows are SHA-256 bound.
Calibration admission requires publishable test gold, complete coverage, at least 200 cases and ECE at most 0.10.
known_boundary: This evaluates raw probabilities only. It does not fit a calibrator, create a calibration version, enable calibrated confidence or change production.
